name: RZ-1 skitter iter
desc: CasioRZ1 12-bit micro-kit whose kick/rim cell rotates one step per cycle via iter(4) so the groove walks over four bars, crisp 16th ghost hats saw-pumping under it, a phrase-end ply fill, and a 32-cycle filter breath. Skittering braindance funk that never repeats the same bar twice.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [~ rim] bd ~ rim ~ [bd rim]").bank("CasioRZ1").iter(4).gain(${gain}).shape(.22), s("hh*16").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(saw.range(.12, .34).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(${gain}*.5).room(${room})).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.5).slow(32)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("[bd bd] ~ rim [~ bd] rim ~ [bd rim] rim").bank("CasioRZ1").iter(4).gain(${gain}).shape(.25), s("hh*16").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(saw.range(.15,.4).fast(4)).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)), s("~ [cp,sd] ~ [cp,sd]").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(${gain}*.55).room(${room}), s("oh(3,8,<0 2 4>)").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(${gain}*.32)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*1.8).slow(16)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply("<1 2>")).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
